name: Locale Utils
description: Byte-size formatting against a configurable unit table (decimal, binary or custom).
notes: No <name>_style.dart / <name>_theme.dart: pure formatter, no token-derived property to theme.
The old top-level `formatFileSize` is not re-declared: `primitives/file_value` owns that name. The locale-configurable formatter is `SizeUnitLocale.format`.
DatePart / TimePart / DurationPart and their helpers are not here: they live in primitives/localizations/locale_parts.dart.
`fileBits` was renamed `binaryBytes`; its units are binary bytes and now include a plain `B`.
